title: Artemis II Honored by Congress

scenes.text: Artemis II crew receive the Congressional Medal of Honor.

scenes.label: FIRST MOON ORBITERS
scenes.text: Artemis II was the first crewed mission to orbit the Moon since 1972.

scenes.label: CONGRESS AWARD
scenes.text: The mission’s crew were awarded the Congressional Medal of Honor for their historic accomplishment.

scenes.label: WHITE HOUSE CEREMONY
scenes.text: The award ceremony took place at the White House, highlighting national pride in space exploration.
Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: Artemis II’s crew earned the Congressional Medal of Honor after becoming the first astronauts to orbit the Moon in decades. Follow for daily science!
